result.reason: The added language substantively reaches the preferred position for termination: up to six months of assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable form, and certified deletion thereafter. However, it applies only upon termination and does not cover expiry, as required. Drafting is otherwise focused and professional, though clause (iv)'s general right to destroy Confidential Information should ideally be made expressly subject to the mandatory data-return obligation in clause (v).
